blocks.text: Sofia Andres has denied claims that she opposes the relationship of Ella Pangilinan and Enrique Miranda, stressing that she does not view family as a competition. Andres addressed the issue through her Instagram Story on Saturday, Oct. 24, after sharing a news item alleging that she was against Pangilinan and Enrique’s relationship. “I want to make one thing clear. Standing up for myself and my family does not mean I am against anyone,” Andres said. “I have never viewed family as a competition.
